item.title: EplayerX 1.2.37
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 新增画面右下角关键词识别与自动跳过，支持自定义关键词和正则规则。 - 支持共享剧集片头片尾标记，改善跳过片头片尾的体验。 - 增强蓝光 ISO、BDMV 和网络共享视频的播放兼容性，改善未标注格式的 ISO 识别，并支持切换光盘标题。 - 优化播放启动和下一集预加载，减少自动选择音轨时的等待。 - 改善跳转进度、预览缩略图和字幕显示的稳定性。 - Seerr 新增 Plex 账号授权登录，并优化登录和请求管理体验。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Added automatic skipping based on keywords detected in the bottom-right corner of the video, with custom keywords and regular expressions. - Added shared episode intro and outro markers for improved intro and outro skipping. - Improved playback compatibility for Blu-ray ISO, BDMV, and network-share videos, including detection of mislabeled ISO files and disc title selection. - Improved playback startup and next-episode preloading, reducing delays during automatic audio-track selection. - Improved the reliability of seeking, preview thumbnails, and subtitle rendering. - Added Plex account authorization for Seerr, with improvements to sign-in and request management.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
